records.label: spacr.timelapse.analyze_calcium_oscillations#13
records.source: ``legacy`` preserves the original global decay fit. Opt-in ``ratio``, ``exponential`` or ``histogram`` uses Measure's per-field correction once on the original table. Raw intensities remain unchanged; ``bleach_corrected_<measurement>`` stores absolute corrected levels. ``corrected_<measurement>`` is dimensionless: corrected signal above the measured outside ring divided by that field's positive, finite initial median signal. Integrated levels subtract ring times area. Missing background or an invalid initial baseline remains NaN; missing intervals are not bridged for peak detection. The actual method, background and baseline accompany traces; ``bleach_correction_fits.csv`` records field fits. Histogram matching can erase population changes.
records.context: ``legacy`` preserves the original global decay fit. Opt-in ``ratio``, ``exponential`` or ``histogram`` uses Measure's per-field correction once on the original table. Raw intensities remain unchanged; ``bleach_corrected_<measurement>`` stores absolute corrected levels. ``corrected_<measurement>`` is dimensionless: corrected signal above the measured outside ring divided by that field's positive, finite initial median signal. Integrated levels subtract ring times area. Missing background or an invalid initial baseline remains NaN; missing intervals are not bridged for peak detection. The actual method, background and baseline accompany traces; ``bleach_correction_fits.csv`` records field fits. Histogram matching can erase population changes.
records.translation: ``legacy`` preserva o ajuste global original do decaimento. A seleção explícita de ``ratio``, ``exponential`` ou ``histogram`` aplica uma única vez à tabela original a correção por campo do Measure. As intensidades brutas permanecem inalteradas; ``bleach_corrected_<measurement>`` armazena níveis absolutos corrigidos. ``corrected_<measurement>`` é adimensional: o sinal corrigido acima do anel externo medido é dividido pela mediana inicial positiva e finita do sinal desse campo. Nos níveis integrados, subtrai-se a intensidade do anel multiplicada pela área. A ausência de fundo ou uma referência inicial inválida resulta em NaN; intervalos ausentes não são conectados para detectar picos. O método efetivamente usado, o fundo e a referência acompanham as curvas; ``bleach_correction_fits.csv`` registra os ajustes por campo. A correspondência de histogramas pode apagar mudanças na população.
